name: Master of Engines
text: Start of fight: Your back-row units each Hit the enemy with the least Health.
golden_text: Start of fight: Your back-row units each Hit the enemy with the least Health twice, choosing again.
reminders: Hit: Deal this unit's Attack as damage. It takes none back.

name: Spoon Catapult
text: Instead of attacking, Hit the enemy with the least Health.
golden_text: Instead of attacking, Hit the enemy with the least Health twice, choosing again.
reminders: Hit: Deal this unit's Attack as damage. It takes none back.

name: Edgewright
text: Start of fight: Your slots give double Attack this fight.
golden_text: Start of fight: Your slots give triple Attack this fight.
reminders: Slot buff: Stays on the slot. Any unit standing there has it.

name: Whetstone Vole
text: At the end of your turn, give this slot +{attack} Attack.
reminders: Slot buff: Stays on the slot. Any unit standing there has it.

name: Grindstone Miller
text: At the end of your turn, give this slot and its neighbours +{attack} Attack.
reminders: Slot buff: Stays on the slot. Any unit standing there has it.
